question: How should `/reasoning stream` be presented in the TUI: transient chat update, footer/status replacement, or only the existing Show thinking history path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the reporter asks for OpenAI/Grok-style overwriting and later footer/status placement, so a maintainer UX choice is needed before implementation cements the wrong behavior.

options.title: Transient chat reasoning
options.body: Render `agent stream=thinking` as a temporary chat entry that updates during the run and clears or collapses when the final answer arrives.

options.title: Footer status reasoning
options.body: Put the latest reasoning delta in the footer/activity status line, matching the reporter's later request but competing with existing run state.

options.title: History-only reasoning
options.body: Do not add live TUI reasoning presentation and instead fix help/docs so users rely on `/reasoning on` plus Show thinking.

recommendation.title: Transient chat reasoning
recommendation.body: Render `agent stream=thinking` as a temporary chat entry that updates during the run and clears or collapses when the final answer arrives.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the `/reasoning` feature and related reasoning-stream UX, making them the best available owner for the TUI contract decision.
